entries.name: Earth surface area
entries.author: NASA Visualization Technology Applications and Development (VTAD)
entries.license: U.S. public-domain NASA media; NASA usage guidelines apply (not CC0)
entries.note: The whole Earth globe is unfolded with the Equal Earth projection. Equal-sized map patches represent equal surface areas under the listed spherical convention; the full colored footprint equals the listed area, not its bounding rectangle. Existing NASA source UVs and imagery are retained without invented terrain. North follows the source globe; longitude is illustrative, not a navigation grid.

entries.name: Lake Tahoe surface
entries.author: Natural Earth contributors
entries.note: Natural Earth generalized lake outline; source-water extent and listed surface-area statistic may differ.

entries.name: New York City
entries.author: U.S. Census Bureau
entries.note: Union of five 1:500,000 Census county outlines clipped to Natural Earth 1:10m land and simplified at 0.0002 degrees. This mixed-scale coastline is generalized: its spherical cylindrical equal-area estimate (R=6378137 m) is 736.005 km2 versus 778.181 km2 in Census county land attributes. The listed 784 km2 is a rounded land-area statistic; neither outline nor calibration represents cadastral shorelines.
